characterizations.result_summary: IR spectrum confirms absence of NH amide group stretching and bending bands at 3500-3100 cm⁻¹ and 1640-1550 cm⁻¹ for degraded PVC with stabilizer.

Thermal stability of three maleyl amide polymer stabilizers was measured, with melamine amide polymer showing highest stability, followed by p-phenylenediamine polymer, then m-phenylenediamine amide polymer.
Weight loss of nonstabilized PVC and PVC stabilized with maleyl amide polymers was measured, with stabilized PVC showing lower weight loss at 320°C.
